title: Demolishing the bootstrap router refunds stock that was never charged — one free router_mid per run
evidence:
core/topology.odin:325:
			inv.routers[t.node_type[ns]] += 1
core/run.odin:66 (bootstrap_map, no tray deduction):
	spawn_node(t, mid, {18, 14}, 0, cat)
data/balance.json (starting_inventory):
    "routers": {
      "router_basic": 2,
      "router_mid": 1
    }
detail: bootstrap_map spawns the mid router without charging the tray while starting_inventory already holds router_mid:1; demolishing the boot node returns +1, so the run yields one extra placement (charged routers net 0 on demolish). Round-2 hotspot: double-return.
recommended_fix: Charge the boot router at bootstrap (deduct 1 from starting_inventory.routers[router_mid]), or refund only inventory-paid nodes via a paid flag set by Cmd_Place_Router.

title: run_destroy is never called; run-lifetime heap arrays (topology maps, flow SLA/rolling, director flags) leak per run
detail: run_init_bare never assigns context.allocator, so the maps, flow SLA/rolling arrays, and director arrays are heap-allocated; grep shows zero run_destroy call sites and run_context_destroy frees only the arena buffer — heap leaks accumulate across restarts.
recommended_fix: Call run_destroy from run_context_destroy and extend it to delete the flow and director arrays, or pass state.allocator explicitly into every init alloc.

title: Demolishing a strained/critical node resets its health slot to Healthy without emitting Ev_Warning_Cleared
detail: The dead-slot branch bypasses the transition emit, so Ev_Warning_Raised has no paired Ev_Warning_Cleared when a node dies while strained — event-stream pairing and raise/clear goldens break.
recommended_fix: Emit Ev_Warning_Cleared before resetting a non-Healthy dead slot (guarded by the previous level) so raises and clears stay symmetric.

title: Severance reroute leaves vis_q8 stale — rerouted packets render at their destination for the whole new route
evidence:
core/flow.odin:489-494 (no vis_q8 reset on reroute):
		cur := current_node(p, t)
		compute_route(f, t, cur, p.dst, p)
		p.edge_idx = 0
		p.progress_units = 0
core/snapshot.odin:207 and 230:
	remaining := p.vis_q8
	return 0, 0, p.dst
detail: vis_q8 was capped by the old route length; after a shorter reroute the packet_edge_pos walk exhausts the new route and returns p.dst, so the packet renders at its destination until it actually arrives.
recommended_fix: Reset vis_q8 when rerouting, e.g. p.vis_q8 = i32(p.id % 64) * 4 * i32(p.route_len) as done at spawn (flow.odin:349).

title: Catalog loader accepts negative grant counts, negative starting stock, and negative set-piece times
evidence:
core/catalog.odin:316-317:
				sp.start_tick = u64(jint(so, "start_tick", 0))
				sp.duration_ticks = u64(jint(so, "duration_ticks", 0))
core/catalog.odin:399, 409, 523:
				g.at_tick = u64(jint(go, "at_tick", 0))
						append(&g.links, Grant_Item{idx = ti, n = i32(n)})
	case json.Integer: return i32(x), true
core/run.odin:158:
				state.inventory.links[it.idx] += it.n
detail: A negative grant n applies straight to the tray (stock goes negative, tier soft-locked by the <= 0 draw check); a negative start_tick/duration wraps to ~2^64 so the surge silently never fires. The loader's fail-fast contract validates neither.
recommended_fix: Reject n < 0 for starting_inventory and grant items, and at_tick/start_tick/duration_ticks < 0, with named errors at load.

title: placement_valid and growth pos_free enforce different spacing metrics — E31's 'shared' rule is not shared
detail: Growth accepts a spawn at (4,4) from a node (Manhattan 8 >= 7) where player placement is rejected (Euclidean squared 32 < 49): growth can place nodes closer than the placement rule allows, contradicting the shared-rule comment.
recommended_fix: Use one distance metric (Manhattan or squared-Euclidean) in placement_valid, pos_free, and min_dist_ok.
